reason: I'd sign up for the 14 days because it's free and no card, but I already get this from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client. At $35k a year I'm not adding another subscription for something I can nearly replicate.
objection: ChatGPT with a saved brief per client already does the voice part. The approval link and CSV export are nice but not worth 19 to 29 a month when my clients just reply on WhatsApp anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Proof in the trial that clients actually approve through the link instead of just replying on WhatsApp, and that the voice is clearly better than my ChatGPT briefs. Or a much cheaper Solo plan that also covers 8 to 10 clients.
